hash_provenance.policy: manifest hash is stored vna_hash field from Vernaux

versym_index_crosscheck.method: collect distinct nonzero .gnu.version (VERSYM) u16 indices and compare against every vna_other
versym_index_crosscheck.note: the only missing indices are the GLIBC_ABI_DT_RELR anchors (version 68/82/78 resp.); no symbol in these objects carries that index, so the VERSYM array never stores it. Manifest records it exactly as stored in Vernaux; not a record defect.
